planned_math_to_code.statement: delta*=d-W^-1 C^T(C W^-1 C^T)^dagger C d; C delta*=0.
If C has full column rank then delta*=0.
For q(delta)=.5 delta^T W delta-delta^T Wd, p=P_W d and r=d-p satisfy p^T W r=0.
For d!=0, rho=||d-p||_W^2/||d||_W^2 is in [0,1]; the constrained/unconstrained local improvement ratio is 1-rho.
Choose scalar s=sqrt(1-rho). Then ||sd||_W=||p||_W and q(0)-q(sd)>=q(0)-q(p), but C(sd)=s Cd.
If C=Dpsi(y) and ||D^2 psi||<=L locally, Cp=0 implies ||psi(y+p)-psi(y)||<=L||p||_2^2/2.

native_experiment.primary_contrast: candidate versus strongest executable simple comparator fixed on development, plus the named operation-isolating comparisons
native_experiment.distinguishing_prediction: Protected linear motion moments stay unchanged while unprotected geometry directions move; benefit should vanish when ker C is trivial. The projected local quadratic gain fraction is 1-rho; equal-W-norm scalar shrinkage has at least its geometry gain but generally changes C y.
native_experiment.falsifier: Reject necessity if the same native geometry/motion frontier is achieved by an equal-cost unconstrained/strength-matched repair, or if protected moments have no relationship to the native motion endpoint.
